Name: Remarks
Abney Park Cemetery: It became the main burial place of English nonconformists when Bunhill Fields closed
Brompton Cemetery: Owned and maintained by The Royal Parks
Highgate Cemetery: Divided into East and West cemeteries
Kensal Green Cemetery: Also known as the General Cemetery of All Souls. The oldest of the Magnificent Seven and still in operation.
Nunhead Cemetery: Also known as "Cemetery of all Saints"
Tower Hamlets Cemetery: Also known as Bow Cemetery. Closed in 1966
West Norwood Cemetery: Originally known as the South Metropolitan Cemetery. The first cemetery in the world designed in the Gothic Revival style
